channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Magnetic bacteria extend worm lifespan by 43%
item.description: A bacterium that produces magnets increased the average lifespan of C. elegans worms by over 43% and helped protect their neurological and intestinal health.

item.title: Two new sea spider species discovered in Salish Sea
item.description: Scientists found two unusual sea spider species in the Salish Sea, including a hairy-legged, red-eyed one that grooms itself with comb-like structures.

item.title: CERN begins disconnecting the Large Hadron Collider
item.description: CERN has started replacing key magnets in the Large Hadron Collider as part of its High-Luminosity upgrade. The new superconducting components are being installed.

item.title: Rare autism-linked genetic disorder may be more common than thought
item.description: A major analysis suggests Phelan-McDermid syndrome, a genetic disorder linked to autism, may affect about 1 in 7,300 people and more than 45,000 overall.
